newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak SAX falls on losses to major shares.
newsitem.headline: Slovak SAX falls on losses to major shares.

text.p: Heavy losses to major Slovak shares dragged the SAX down 4.35 points to 185.58 in flat trading on the Bratislava Stock Exchange (BSE) on Friday, with brokers seeing no sign of improvement.
Oil refiner Slovnaft and steel maker VSZ, the two biggest Slovak issues, both fell, in terms of their average prices for the day, by 5.0 percent and 6.9 percent respectively.
Slovnaft closed at 950, with only 42 shares traded, while VSZ traded 220 shares and closed at 650.

"Theoretically, the prices in VSZ and Slovnaft may look attractively low, but I'm afraid the current depression on the BSE is so deep that there will be no significant interest in them," Libor Briska of Creditanstalt said.
Almost all Slovak blue chips declined on low volumes and overall trading figures were boosted only by direct trades.
Overall, volume eased to 376,910 shares from 503,260 shares on Thursday, while turnover decreased to 338.1 million crowns, from 559.97 million.
